actions.title: Treasury ladder for idle cash
actions.summary: Put $500k above the $120k reserve into Treasuries that mature with the plan's dates (Reduce single-issuer concentration, Maintain a four-year liquidity plan).

actions.title: Gift appreciated HCYN shares to a donor-advised fund
actions.summary: Give $250k of low-basis shares instead of cash, avoiding about $219k of realized gain.
actions.fit: Fits only if the client has charitable goals; ask before proposing.
cautions: Ask about charitable intent first; nothing is on file.
Gifts by an affiliate still follow the insider policy.

actions.title: Exchange fund for low-basis HCYN shares
actions.summary: Swap concentrated shares into a diversified fund without an immediate taxable sale.
actions.fit: Not suitable: a 7-year lock-up exceeds the 4-year planning horizon.

evidence.title: House-view update · HCYN · Constructive · consistent with the house view
evidence.text: EPS was $1.79 versus $1.62 consensus, a 10.5% beat. Revenue was $1.51B, up 42.6% year over year and 5.0% above consensus. FY2026 revenue guidance rose to $5.75B–$5.85B from $5.45B–$5.6B, with the midpoint up 5.0%. The earnings beat record remains strong at 87.5% across 8 observations, including a 4-quarter beat streak. Valuation remains supportive of the house view: forward P/E is 11.5x versus a 18.4x peer median, a 24.1% discount.
